Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a mistake by concluding that the Scottish Parliament has been based at The Mound in Edinburgh since 2004. This is incorrect; the Scottish Parliament has been based in the Scottish Parliament Building at Holyrood, Edinburgh, since its opening in 2004. The mistake reflects an incorrect assumption or misunderstanding of the location based on previous historical uses of The Mound as a meeting site for the General Assembly, but not applicable since 2004 for the modern Parliament.
